title: How to Generate Real Estate Leads in India: Free and Paid Methods
seoTitle: How to Generate Real Estate Leads in India (Free & Paid)
excerpt: How to generate real estate leads in India for free and with ads: Google Business Profile, portals, referrals, Meta and Google ads, and fixing junk leads.
imageAlt: A man in a suit talking on a desk phone in his office

inlineImages.alt: A property advisor going through papers with a young couple inside an apartment

faqs.question: How can I generate real estate leads in India?
faqs.answer: Combine free sources such as a Google Business Profile, referrals, portal listings and walkthrough videos with paid sources such as Google search ads and Meta ads sent to a project landing page. Then compare every source on cost per site visit rather than the number of enquiries.

faqs.question: How do I generate real estate leads for free in India?
faqs.answer: Complete your Google Business Profile and ask happy clients for reviews, list on property portals, ask every past buyer for referrals, post walkthrough and locality videos with your WhatsApp number, register with RERA and work with developers as a channel partner, and reply instantly to every enquiry.

faqs.question: What are the best paid ways to get real estate leads?
faqs.answer: Google search ads for people already searching a locality or project, Meta ads for launches, EOI drives and retargeting, and paid portal plans for visibility. Send ads to a project landing page, track each lead to its ad, and judge every channel on site visits.

faqs.question: Does Google have a lead generation program for real estate in India?
faqs.answer: Google doesn't sell leads. It offers Google Ads, including search ads, lead form assets and Performance Max, plus a free Google Business Profile for local visibility. The leads come from how well you target, what your landing page shows and how fast you follow up.

faqs.question: Why are my real estate leads junk?
faqs.answer: Usually because forms are too easy to submit, the ad hides the price band, the platforms optimise for form fills, Google ads match irrelevant searches, or the lead was called too late. Fix it with qualifying questions, visible prices, conversion data sent back, negative keywords and instant WhatsApp replies.

faqs.question: Should I buy real estate leads or phone number databases?
faqs.answer: Avoid bought number lists. The people never agreed to be contacted, TRAI's 2025 amendments speed up action against spam senders, and the DPDP Act, 2023 requires consent for a clear purpose. Pay-per-lead services that run their own ads are different, but check exclusivity and site visits.

faqs.question: How quickly should I respond to a property lead?
faqs.answer: Within minutes, ideally seconds. Buyers often enquire with several projects the same evening, and the first to reply with the price sheet and a visit slot is well placed to get the visit. A WhatsApp chatbot on the official Business Platform makes that possible at any hour.

faqs.question: How should I measure real estate lead generation?
faqs.answer: Track spend, enquiries, contacted, qualified, site visits and bookings for every source in one monthly table, and compare sources on cost per site visit. Move budget towards the cheapest source of visits and cut the rest, however good their lead counts look.
